_comment: REPO-ROOT git config — MEASURED INEFFECTIVE (kept as documentation of the result, not as a working lever). History: the 2026-06-16 preview-churn fix (deploy main only — the preview fan-out blew Vercel's 100/day cap) was placed in app/vercel.json and measured not working; this repo-root copy was the next hypothesis (config evaluated from the default branch after merge). RESULT 2026-07-03: with this file ON main (merged in d0d2cd5), the very next branch push (PR #522, 3794094) still fired a preview deployment ('Ready' at 12:09 UTC). Both in-repo placements are now measured dead for this project. UPDATE 2026-10-21: the Cloudflare Pages cutover listed here as a remaining lever WAS TAKEN, and it is what serves production now — the Pages project poetech-app holds poetech.us and www.poetech.us, every road probed there answered signed pages-function, and deploy-cloudflare-pages.yml is producing real successes on main (90ac836 at 15:45Z). So VERCEL NO LONGER SERVES THE SITE, and the serving config in app/vercel.json is dead with it (kept rather than pruned: the Root Directory setting still reads it, and a rollback to Vercel would need it). What remains is COSMETIC NOISE, not an outage: the integration still builds per push and still posts a `Vercel` commit status, which goes red once the Hobby 100/day cap is spent — it was, on 2026-10-21, on every open PR. It blocks nothing, measured: PR #2366 merged at 15:53Z carrying `Vercel: failure` and an overall combined status of `failure`. A red Vercel is never evidence about the live site; site-health.yml measures that (DR-0125). Silencing it for good is the one lever still DASHBOARD-side and Darrell's own hand: Project Settings -> Git -> disable deployments, or disconnect the integration. Nothing in this repository can reach it — that is the measured result this file exists to record.
